mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Use the attached reference images.
Reference images 1 and 2 are style references only: match their flat posterized colour fills in a few hard-edged tonal steps, thin dark ink outlines, small ink tick and hatch marks for texture, and muted naturalistic palette of moss greens, earth browns and grey stone; do not copy their subjects.
Reference image 3 is the composition to keep: keep this exact subject and layout (the dark round shaft opening in rocky forest ground seen from above, the pole ladder lashed to a stake at the lip going down into the dark, pines and boulders around) but redraw it entirely in the style of references 1 and 2.
Reference image 4 shows the same ladder seen from the bottom of the shaft: draw the ladder identically - two straight peeled wooden poles with round rungs lashed on with rope at every joint.
Subject: the top of a ladder at the lip of a deep dark round hole in rocky ground among pine trees, seen from above, the top rungs of a simple wooden pole ladder lashed with rope to a wooden stake at the lip and going down into darkness, daylight.
A full-bleed painted game card scene filling the whole 2:3 portrait canvas edge to edge, realistic proportions, flat cel-like colour, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture, no glow, no glossy highlights, no people, no text, no border, no frame.
Avoid: watercolour, soft painterly shading, warm golden light, photo, 3D render, pixel art, white margin, text, watermark
